controls.Shift: boost in a car, sprint on foot

how_to_run: Serve game/ with any static server (node serve.ts) and open game/index.html in desktop Chrome. ?seed=1337 fixes the world; ?lowfx=1 trims the scene.
systems: 3D open world: 9x9 road grid with Palm Casino, Bay Mall, Docks, Safehouse, Sunset Garage
Day/night cycle and traffic lights; running a red light raises wanted
Traffic cars and pedestrians on the streets
Car stealing (1 star), 1-5 star wanted level, police chases that stop short instead of ramming
Five missions for Slim Vasquez and Rosa Marin: m1 +$300, m2 +$600, m3 +$500 (90s), m4 +$800, m5 +$2,500
On-foot and in-car combat (punch), busted/wasted with respawn fine
LocalStorage save with Continue on the title screen
HUD: cash, wanted stars, health, car condition, objective, mission timer, toasts
WebAudio engine, siren, punch and cash sounds with mute
tagline: Cole Vance, $250, one city, five jobs — an open-world crime game in the spirit of GTA 6.
tech: three.js r160, vendored minified as game/vendor/three.module.min.js
Plain ES modules, no build step, no network request at play time
Node 22 entrypoint main.ts copies game/ and screenshots/ and writes dossier.json
title: SUNSET BAY
